record.paper_title: New results and open problems on Toeplitz operators in Bergman spaces
record.context_brief: Fredholm theory for piecewise continuous symbols
record.original_question: Extend the Fredholm theory for Toeplitz operators on the Bergman space A^2 with piecewise continuous symbols to the general Bergman spaces A^p on the unit disk. The paper also asks for the corresponding theory when the piecewise continuous symbols are matrix-valued.

evidence.quote: Problem 6. Extend Fredholm theory of Toeplitz operators on A2 with piecewise continuous symbols to other Bergman spaces Ap. Also consider matrix-valued piecewise continuous symbols.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{D}$ denote the open unit disk in $\mathbb{C}$ and, for $1<p<\infty$, let $A^p=A^p(\mathbb{D})$ be the Bergman space of analytic functions $f:\mathbb{D}\to\mathbb{C}$ with $\|f\|_{A^p}^p=\int_{\mathbb{D}}|f(z)|^p\,dA(z)<\infty$, where $dA$ is normalized area measure. Let $P$ denote the Bergman projection from $L^p(\mathbb{D},dA)$ onto $A^p$. For a bounded measurable symbol $a:\mathbb{D}\to\mathbb{C}$, the Toeplitz operator $T_a:A^p\to A^p$ is defined by $T_af=P(af)$. A symbol $a\in L^\infty(\mathbb{D})$ is called piecewise continuous if it is continuous on $\overline{\mathbb{D}}$ outside a finite set of boundary points $\{\zeta_1,\dots,\zeta_N\}\subset\partial\mathbb{D}$, at each of which $a$ admits finite one-sided non-tangential limits along the two arcs of $\partial\mathbb{D}$ meeting at $\zeta_j$ (and along curves inside $\mathbb{D}$ ending at $\zeta_j$). 

(a) Develop a Fredholm theory for Toeplitz operators $T_a$ on $A^p(\mathbb{D})$ with piecewise continuous symbols $a$: namely, give a complete description of the essential spectrum of $T_a$ and a formula for the Fredholm index of $T_a$ when it is Fredholm, valid for all $1<p<\infty$.

(b) Extend this Fredholm theory to the matrix-valued setting: for $T_A$ acting on $(A^p)^n$ with $A$ an $n\times n$ matrix whose entries are piecewise continuous symbols, characterize Fredholmness, describe the essential spectrum, and give an index formula.
artifact.status_search_result: Classical Fredholm theory for Toeplitz operators with piecewise continuous symbols on $A^2(\mathbb{D})$ is known (Vasilevski and collaborators), and various partial extensions to $A^p$ and weighted Bergman spaces, as well as block/matrix-valued symbol settings, have appeared in subsequent literature (e.g., Taskinen–Virtanen, and the Douglas-type index formula for block Toeplitz operators on Bergman spaces of the ball). However, no single reference establishing a complete Fredholm theory (essential spectrum plus index formula) for piecewise continuous, possibly matrix-valued symbols on $A^p(\mathbb{D})$ for all $1<p<\infty$ was located, so the present status is best described as partially addressed but not conclusively settled.

status_evidence.title: On Fredholm properties of Toeplitz operators in Bergman spaces (Taskinen, 2020)
status_evidence.snippet: Studies Fredholm properties of Toeplitz operators on Bergman spaces, extending VMO-based results.
status_evidence.claim: Progress on Fredholm theory on $A^p$, but not specifically with piecewise continuous symbols in full generality.

status_evidence.title: The Index Formula of Douglas for Block Toeplitz Operators on the Bergman Space of the Ball
status_evidence.snippet: Index formula for Fredholm Toeplitz operators with discontinuous matrix symbols on $A^p$ of the ball.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results in the matrix-valued discontinuous-symbol setting exist.

status_evidence.title: On the Toeplitz Operators with Piecewise Continuous Symbols on the Bergman Space
status_evidence.snippet: Detailed Fredholm theory for piecewise continuous symbols on $A^2(\mathbb{D})$.
status_evidence.claim: Baseline $p=2$ theory is established; extension to $A^p$ is the open question.
